# MIUI Security Center Mod **The MIUI Security Center, based on the CN build, with exclusive features unlocked.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/MiuiSecurityMod?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/MiuiSecurityMod/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/MiuiSecurityMod/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/MiuiSecurityMod/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/MiuiSecurityMod?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/MiuiSecurityMod/stargazers)
> [!WARNING] > **Legacy MIUI project. No longer updated.** It's kept for MIUI 12–13 users. HyperOS users: see [HyperOS Security Center Mod](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Security-Center). ## Features - Based on the CN Security Center, works on Global/CN/Xiaomi.eu ROMs - Translations from Xiaomi.eu - Exclusive features unlocked - Security score always 100 - Battery status UI changes - Shutdown confirmation - Incognito mode ## Requirements - MIUI 12–13, Android 10 or newer - Magisk ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/MiuiSecurityMod/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk. 3. Reboot your device. ## Notes - If you use this in your ROM, please credit Mods Center. Not for paid ROMs. ## Screenshots

MIUI Security Center Mod

The MIUI Security Center, based on the CN build, with exclusive features unlocked.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/MiuiSecurityMod/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/MiuiSecurityMod/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/MiuiSecurityMod/stargazers)

> [!WARNING]

> Legacy MIUI project. No longer updated. It's kept for MIUI 12–13 users. HyperOS users: see HyperOS Security Center Mod.

Features

  • Based on the CN Security Center, works on Global/CN/Xiaomi.eu ROMs
  • Translations from Xiaomi.eu
  • Exclusive features unlocked
  • Security score always 100
  • Battery status UI changes
  • Shutdown confirmation
  • Incognito mode

    • Requirements

  • MIUI 12–13, Android 10 or newer
  • Magisk

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/MiuiSecurityMod/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk.
  • Reboot your device.

    • Notes

  • If you use this in your ROM, please credit Mods Center. Not for paid ROMs.
